title: Genomics England current data location catalog
scope: Latest 100kGP v19, NHS GMS v5, COVID-19 v7 and current AggV3

path_semantics.file: Exact published object or file path
path_semantics.prefix: Published directory or S3 prefix; list or resolve objects in-environment
path_semantics.template: Published structure with placeholders and a concrete shaped example
path_semantics.derived-file: Filename derived from a current data-dictionary table identifier
path_semantics.access-point: LabKey folder, schema and table where no filesystem path is published

data_dictionaries.name: GMS_data_dictionary_v5.xlsx

data_dictionaries.name: covid_19_release7_dictionary.xlsx

important_notes: Resolve participant genomic paths through the latest LabKey release.
Do not discover genomes by directory traversal; consent may have changed.
GMS v5 clinical entries include exact structured-data object paths.
CloudOS availability differs by modality; S3 prefixes do not imply permission.
